'''''Forum of Mathematics, Pi''''' and '''''Forum of Mathematics, Sigma''''' are [[open-access]] [[peer-reviewed]] journals for [[mathematics]] published under a [[creative commons]] license by [[Cambridge University Press]].<ref name="fmp-home">{{cite web|title=Forum of Mathematics, Pi|publisher=Cambridge University Press|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/forum-of-mathematics-pi|accessdate=29 May 2021}}</ref><ref name="fms-home">{{cite web|title=Forum of Mathematics, Sigma|publisher=Cambridge University Press|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/forum-of-mathematics-sigma|accessdate=29 May 2021}}</ref> 
The founding [[editor-in-chief|managing editor]] was [[Robion Kirby|Rob Kirby]].<ref name=announce>{{cite web|title=Cambridge University Press launches open access maths journals|publisher=Cambridge University Press|url=https://www.cam.ac.uk/news/cambridge-university-press-launches-open-access-maths-journals|accessdate=8 March 2020}}</ref> He was succeeded by [[Robert Guralnick]], who is currently the managing editor of both journals.<ref name=pi-board>{{cite web|title=Editorial Board|work=Forum of Mathematics Pi|publisher=Cambridge University Press|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/forum-of-mathematics-pi/information/editorial-board|accessdate=8 March 2020}}</ref><ref name=sigma-board>{{cite web|title=Editorial Board|work=Forum of Mathematics, Sigma|publisher=Cambridge University Press|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/forum-of-mathematics-sigma/information/editorial-board|accessdate=8 March 2020}}</ref>

''Forum of Mathematics, Pi'' publishes articles of interest to a wide audience of mathematicians, while ''Forum of Mathematics, Sigma'' is intended for more specialized articles, with clusters of editors in different [[areas of mathematics]].<ref name=about>{{cite web|title=About Pi and Sigma|work=Forum of Mathematics, Pi and Forum of Mathematics, Sigma information|publisher=Cambridge University Press|url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/forum-of-mathematics-sigma/information/forum-of-mathematics-pi-and-forum-of-mathematics-sigma-information|accessdate=8 March 2020}}</ref><ref name=ams>{{cite web|title=Math journals open up, by Bernard Lane. The Australian, 6 July 2012.|work=Math in the Media|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|url=http://www.ams.org/publicoutreach/math-in-the-media/mathdigest-md-201207-toc#201208-tao|accessdate=8 March 2020}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
Both journals are abstracted and indexed in [[Science Citation Index Expanded]],<ref name=ISIpi>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/search-results?issn=2050-5086 |title=Forum of Mathematics, Pi |publisher=[[Clarivate Analytics]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |accessdate=2020-02-16}}</ref><ref name=ISIsigma>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/search-results?issn=2050-5094 |title=Forum of Mathematics, Sigma |publisher=[[Clarivate Analytics]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |accessdate=2020-02-16}}</ref> [[MathSciNet]],<ref name=MathSciNetPi>{{cite web |url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/search/journal/profile?groupId=6135 |title=Forum of Mathematics, PI |publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]] |work=[[MathSciNet]] |access-date=2020-02-16}}</ref><ref name=MathSciNetSigma>{{cite web |url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/search/journal/profile?groupId=6136 |title=Forum of Mathematics, Sigma |publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]] |work=[[MathSciNet]] |access-date=2020-02-16}}</ref> and [[Scopus]].<ref name=ScopusPi>{{cite web |url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/21100887442 |title=Source details: Forum of Mathematics, Pi |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |work=Scopus Preview |accessdate=2020-02-16}}</ref><ref name=ScopusSigma>{{cite web |url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/21100886430 |title=Source details: Forum of Mathematics, Sigma |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |work=Scopus Preview |accessdate=2020-02-16}}</ref>
